title: Outbound: how does an approved email draft get sent through Gmail?
scope: Email branch of sendMessage: owner clicks Send, row is claimed, guards run, Gmail sends, status is written.
omissions: LinkedIn sends via the browser worker; X DMs marked sent by hand
Finding, research, enrollment and the reply-check cron

notes.title: Atomic claim on click
notes.text: Only draft/failed outbound rows are claimed as 'sending' (edits saved); others return skipped, so a double click sends once. A crash mid-send can leave a row stuck in 'sending'.

notes.title: Mixed guard failure modes
notes.text: Daily limit fails the row. The prior-reply check is fail-open (errors count as 0). The Gmail in-touch check fails closed, skipped for replies or owner override; hits are saved.

notes.title: Failure paths are retryable
notes.text: No usable/bounced email, no Gmail connection, or a send error marks the row failed (send errors also recorded as a Gmail connection error). Failed rows can be claimed again.
